title: Maybe some of you, like me, always wanted a tycoon game just about energy systems
author: Electricvid
selftext:
I shared Powerstate here a few weeks ago and got a lot more feedback than I expected. I have worked through quite a bit of it since then and the game has improved a lot.

Households can now adopt solar, batteries, heat pumps, EVs and insulation based on economics. I also improved dispatch, storage, hydrogen, saves and quite a few parts of the UI and balancing.

There is still a lot to improve, but maybe some of you enjoy this kind of overly specific tycoon game as much as I do :)

You can play it directly in the browser (100% free):

[https://powerstate-game.com](https://powerstate-game.com)

Would love to get some more feedback!

I use agentic AI heavily for implementation, but 100 percent of what gets built is specified and directed by me. Features, mechanics and simulation behavior are developed iteratively, not generated from a single prompt.

Cheers!

comments.author: Striking_Procedure40
comments.body: An idea for some low hanging fruit that makes the game more engaging have real world scenarios so for example, what happened in Texas a couple years ago we had snow fall down. They had low axis to resources in order to build. You can also have tax events right that decrease the amount of money that you’re able to put into the generation. This is actually a really cool concept. I’m excited to see where you go with this. I think you could make this more than a pregame. I would pay for a game that was fully flushed out that let me challenge myself against demand planners in the real world who have run into these issues.

replies.author: Electricvid
replies.body: Yes!!! Have it on the horizon but the game it self needs some improvements first.
